title: Elephant vs Rhino — Who Wins?
description: An African elephant against a white rhino. San Diego Zoo reports the largest elephant on record, an adult male savanna elephant, at about 24,000 pounds and 13 feet at the shoulder; the heaviest rhino, the white rhino, at 6,000 pounds. In Hluhluwe-Umfolozi Park, elephants killed 58 white and 5 black rhinos between 1991 and 2001, mostly young males entering musth. The on-screen verdict is based on the listed weights only; it is not evidence of who would win a real fight. Hypothetical matchup.
